definitions.explanation: The area or people around someone or something.
The distance around the edge of something.

examples.english: Be careful not to trouble the people around you.

notes:
{周囲|しゅうい} refers to surroundings (people or environment) or physical circumference.

MEANING 1 - SURROUNDINGS:
- {周囲|しゅうい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (people around [someone])
- {周囲|しゅうい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧ (surrounding environment)
- {周囲|しゅうい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}を{配|くば}る→気を配る：26559_kiwokubaru⟧ (to be mindful of one's surroundings)
- {周囲|しゅうい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (others' eyes, public scrutiny)

MEANING 2 - CIRCUMFERENCE:
- {周囲|しゅうい}○○⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧ (circumference of XX meters)
- ⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧ / ウエスト{周囲|しゅうい} (waist circumference)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {周囲|しゅうい}: surroundings (physical or social)
- ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧: around, vicinity (more casual)
- ⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧: neighborhood (residential area)
- ⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧: environment (broader concept)
